name: hacklm-memory
description: Persistent memory layer for VS Code Copilot — learn from interactions, retain insights, improve over time

languageModelTools.name: hacklm-memory_store_memory
languageModelTools.userDescription: Save a durable insight about this project for future sessions.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Store a durable insight about this project that would help in future sessions. Only store things that will matter next week. ALWAYS query first to avoid duplicates. Categories: Instruction (how to behave), Quirk (project-specific weirdness), Preference (style/design choices), Decision (architectural commitments), Security (rules that must never be broken).

content.description: The insight to store. Should be clear, actionable, and durable. Keep it to one concise line.

languageModelTools.name: hacklm-memory_query_memory
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search stored memories for relevant principles, preferences, and decisions.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search stored memories for relevant principles, preferences, best practices, and decisions. Call this before answering questions about architecture, conventions, style, or any topic where prior context would help. Returns the most relevant entries ranked by keyword match and recency.

query.description: Search query — keywords or a natural language question

category.description: Optional: filter to a specific category

hacklm-memory.autoCleanupFrequency.description: Run cleanup automatically after this many store_memory calls

hacklm-memory.categoryLimit.Instruction.description: Max memories to keep in Instruction category

hacklm-memory.categoryLimit.Quirk.description: Max memories to keep in Quirk category

hacklm-memory.categoryLimit.Preference.description: Max memories to keep in Preference category

hacklm-memory.categoryLimit.Decision.description: Max memories to keep in Decision category

hacklm-memory.categoryLimit.Security.description: Max memories to keep in Security category
